title: A plain answer with no "?" is not read as an ack
why: Coordinator, 14:12 CST Nov 7: after the notes-fix-large-2 pick, a plain answer that holds no "?" still reads as an ack.
note: Incident, 14:47 CST: triage read the owner's note "I'm pretty sure you can do this" on item 361 as a yes to delete 611 Neon branches, against ruling 332 b (sessions never touch Neon). The coordinator caught it before any act. A vague hand-back note is not a yes to an act that cannot be undone.
